collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DISABILITY AND HUMAN DIVERSITY (DIV-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Disabled villagers, chronic illness and every kind of body, skin, hair and face: wheelchairs with real wheels, crutches, canes, ear trumpets, signs and lenses made from island materials; good days and hard days; competence, humor and opinions. Sometimes the difference is the story. Often it's just part of the scenery.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult and a child aged 4-12; in the story (name1) has no hair at all)

collection.description: A child is working up to a question for a villager who has no hair at all: let the child ask, or offer to let them decorate it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has no hair at all, and hasn't for years. It just stopped growing one season and never came back, and (subject.he/she) got used to it, then got fond of it. (subject.He/she) likes the sun on (subject.his/her) head, and the rain, and never having to untangle anything. Today (friend) has been staring at (subject.him/her) with great curiosity, working up to a question.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "Where did your hair go?" asks (friend). "It went on a trip," says (subject). "It never wrote." (friend) considers this. "Does your head get cold?" "Sometimes. Then I wear a wrap." (friend) nods seriously, satisfied, and then asks if (friend.he/she) can touch it. (subject) says yes. (friend) pats (subject.his/her) head once, gravely, like blessing a coconut, and runs off.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) is getting ready for a celebration, and has (subject.his/her) own idea: painted patterns, all over (subject.his/her) head. (subject.He/she) asks (friend) to help. (friend) paints spirals, stars, a fish and a slightly wobbly turtle. (subject) is delighted with it. At the celebration, three people ask who painted it, and (friend) explodes with pride.

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only
